title: Campaigns, live funnels and active automations are metered, and automation and campaigns open to the free Space
detail:
PHASE 2 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). TARGET: merged before 2026-11-24, because pricing_settings.beta_grace ends 2026-12-01 and every count limit enforces that day with no deploy. New keys space_campaigns_month (2 with a Frequency footer / unlimited), space_funnels (0/5/unlimited), space_automations_active (1/10/unlimited), space_entry_points (3/unlimited). The default-deny automation key stops locking the free Space to zero runs: 1 automation, 100 runs a month.

SCOPE NOTE (2026-10-06, same unmerged change that filed the row): Entry Points were dropped from this row and its probe. Entry Points today belong to a member (qr_codes with owner_profile_id, Crew-gated), and a Space has no Entry Point of its own to count; a Space's codes are space_qr. Like multi-pipeline (owner ruling 16:57: drop from the page until built), Space Entry Points come off the pricing page until they exist. Live funnels count as live splash pages on a Space's codes, the only per-Space funnel that exists (the funnels table is admin-only, no space_id).

Campaigns a month, live splash pages and active automations metered at schedule/send, splash set and sequence enable. space_automation and space_campaigns gates moved to the free floor (operator override still binds); the default-deny automation entitlement read is replaced by spaceAutomationAllowed. Free Space campaigns carry a Frequency footer. Entry Points dropped: no Space-owned Entry Points exist.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const lim=(()=>{const s=r("lib/pricing/meter-limits.ts");const a=s.indexOf("PLACEHOLDER_METER_LIMITS");const b=s.indexOf("= {",a);const e=s.indexOf("\n}\n",b);return Function("return "+s.slice(b+2,e+2).replace(/\/\/.*$/gm,"").replace(/(\d)_(\d)/g,"$1$2"))()})();const want=(k,t,v)=>{const row=lim[k];if(!row)fail(k+" is not a meter yet");if(!(t in row)||row[t]!==v)fail(k+"."+t+" is "+JSON.stringify(row[t])+", the ladder says "+JSON.stringify(v))};const walk=(d,o=[])=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return o;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=d+"/"+f.name;if(f.isDirectory()){if(f.name!=="node_modules")walk(p,o)}else if(/\.tsx?$/.test(f.name)&&!/\.test\./.test(f.name))o.push(p)}return o};const src=[...walk("lib"),...walk("app")].filter((f)=>!f.startsWith("lib/pricing/")).map((f)=>[f,r(f)]);const usedAt=(k,seam)=>src.some(([f,s])=>s.includes(JSON.stringify(k).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(39)))&&seam.test(s));want("space_campaigns_month","free",2);want("space_funnels","free",0);want("space_funnels","business",5);want("space_automations_active","free",1);want("space_automations_active","business",10);const seam=/spaceAllowance(Verdict|Headroom)\(/;const miss=["space_campaigns_month","space_funnels","space_automations_active"].filter((k)=>!usedAt(k,seam));if(miss.length)fail("no write path asks: "+miss.join(","));console.log("ok: marketing meters exist and automation is open to free")'
